Bundled encoder from @jsquash/webp 1.5.0.
Source: https://github.com/jamsinclair/jSquash
webp_enc.mjs is the unmodified codec/enc/webp_enc.js renamed to .mjs.
meta.mjs is the unmodified meta.js renamed to .mjs.
Apache-2.0 license is included in LICENSE.
worker.mjs is the guild-specific wrapper. No external CDN is used at runtime.
